description: Dietary supplement products reported by NHANES participants, with product classifications, information sources, serving sizes, and ingredient-category counts.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: NHANES current product identifier in the form nhanes:{int(DSDPID)}.

common_properties.name: serving_quantity
common_properties.description: Serving quantity; the serving unit is provided separately when available.

common_properties.name: vitamins_count
common_properties.description: Number of vitamin ingredients in the product; zero when none.

common_properties.name: minerals_count
common_properties.description: Number of mineral ingredients in the product; zero when none.

common_properties.name: amino_acids_count
common_properties.description: Number of amino-acid ingredients in the product; zero when none.

common_properties.name: botanicals_count
common_properties.description: Number of botanical ingredients in the product; zero when none.

common_properties.name: other_count
common_properties.description: Number of other ingredients in the product; zero when none.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the product record; includes NHANES.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the product record was created or last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Products in the cumulative NHANES Dietary Supplement Database Product Information file, including Default products.
source_contributions.description: Published by the CDC / National Center for Health Statistics. Product classifications and serving units are stored as human-readable labels. Each coded property is absent when its value is missing, unmapped, or labeled Missing or Unknown; serving quantity remains available even when serving unit is absent.

properties.name: product_type
properties.description: Product type: Regular, Generic, or Default. Default products are generic/inferred entries for participant reports with insufficient detail to identify a specific labeled product.

properties.name: supplement_type
properties.description: Supplement type: Infant/pediatric, Prenatal, Mature, or Standard.

properties.name: information_source
properties.description: Source of product information: Directly from manufacturer; Directly from distributor; Inferred from supplement name; Physician's Desk Reference; Product Catalog; Internet Listing; Supplement label or carton; Supplement from same manufacturer; or Dietary Supplement Label Database.

properties.name: serving_unit
properties.description: Unit of the serving quantity: Caplet, Capsule, Dropper, Drop, Fluid Ounce, Gel Cap, Lozenge, Milliliter, Package/Packet, Pill, Tablespoon/Powder, Softgel, Tablespoon/Liquid, Tablet, Teaspoon/Liquid, Wafer, Ounce/Powder, Spray/Squirt, Scoop/Powder, Cup/Powder, Chew, Vegicap, Can/Liquid, Capful, Gumball, Gram/Powder, Teaspoon/Powder, Cup/Liquid, Gram/Liquid, Drop/Lozenge, Strip, or Bottle/Liquid.
